env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=

go run ./plain
stderr '^selection-ok$'
# Plain go detects LoGOs sources and re-executes as logos, which
# reports the module's real problem instead of "no Go files".
! go build ./only
! stderr 'no Go files'
stderr 'ignored\.lgo'
! go build ./importer
! stderr 'no Go files'
stderr 'ignored\.lgo'
! go build ./...
! stderr 'no Go files'
stderr 'ignored\.lgo'
